entries.summary: Slop of the day counts only fair votes
entries.details_markdown: Every vote still shows on a slop, whenever it's cast. The daily race now counts only the votes cast on its own day (votes in the minute after midnight used to slip in), and leaves out votes from accounts less than a day old, downvotes from makers racing the same day, and upvotes two racing makers swap. The rules page says what counts.

entries.summary: Every day is a UTC day
entries.details_markdown: Launches, goal days and streaks now all end at midnight UTC, the same moment for everyone, like slop of the day already did. A slop thrown at 23:55 UTC counts for that day even where it's already past midnight, so a late one no longer looks like a missed day. Settings shows times in your time zone, and the goal form says when midnight UTC is there.

entries.summary: Look anyone up from the API without signing in
entries.details_markdown: Anyone's profile, with their goal day by day, streak and slops, is now at `/api/v1/users/{username}` and the `get_profile` agent tool. That profile, today's race, search, categories, tags and reviews all work without an API token, at up to 120 calls an hour from one address. Signed in, everything works, at up to 1,200 calls an hour, and a call over the limit says when to try again.

entries.summary: Sharing to LinkedIn fills in the post
entries.details_markdown: The LinkedIn share button opened an empty post box with only the link. It now opens LinkedIn's composer with the same text as the other networks, followed by the link.

entries.summary: Votes go through while slops are launching
entries.details_markdown: A vote could fail with an error when lots of slops were launching at the same moment. It now goes through.
